text_simplified: The text discusses a noble hadith that advises on rifq (gentleness) with children and their care. The hadith mentions that whoever does not show mercy to the young and does not acknowledge the rights of the elders is not among the Muslims. It also highlights the importance of tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon good akhlaq (character).

review_defects.why: The English title is a transliteration, not a translation, so the meaning 'Gentleness with Children in the Prophetic Hadith' is not conveyed to English readers.
The Arabic explicitly says 'Prophetic noble hadith' (hadith nabwi sharif), but the English omits 'Prophetic', weakening the attribution to the Prophet ﷺ.
The Arabic singular 'right' (haqq) is rendered as plural 'rights', slightly altering the nuance of the hadith paraphrase.
